+import XCTest
+
+final class BlueskyUITests: XCTestCase {
+    func testSearchNewsAndSelectFeeds() {
+        let app = XCUIApplication(bundleIdentifier: "xyz.blueskyweb.app")
+        let springboard = XCUIApplication(bundleIdentifier: "com.apple.springboard")
+        let safari = XCUIApplication(bundleIdentifier: "com.apple.mobilesafari")
+
+        let openButton = springboard.buttons["Open"]
+        if openButton.waitForExistence(timeout: 5) {
+            openButton.tap()
+        } else {
+            let safariOpen = safari.alerts.buttons["Open"]
+            if safariOpen.waitForExistence(timeout: 2) {
+                safariOpen.tap()
+            }
+        }
+
+        app.activate()
+        sleep(2)
+        NSLog("BLUESKY TREE AFTER OPEN: %@", app.debugDescription)
+
+        let searchButton = app.buttons["Search"]
+        if searchButton.waitForExistence(timeout: 3) {
+            searchButton.tap()
+        } else {
+            app.coordinate(withNormalizedOffset: CGVector(dx: 0.31, dy: 0.93)).tap()
+        }
+        sleep(2)
+        NSLog("BLUESKY TREE ON SEARCH: %@", app.debugDescription)
+
+        let searchField = app.textFields.firstMatch
+        if searchField.waitForExistence(timeout: 5) {
+            searchField.tap()
+            searchField.typeText("news")
+            app.keyboards.buttons["Search"].tap()
+        }
+        sleep(3)
+        NSLog("BLUESKY TREE ON RESULTS: %@", app.debugDescription)
+
+        let feedsTab = app.buttons["Feeds"]
+        if feedsTab.waitForExistence(timeout: 3) {
+            feedsTab.tap()
+        } else {
+            app.coordinate(withNormalizedOffset: CGVector(dx: 0.60, dy: 0.22)).tap()
+        }
+        sleep(2)
+        NSLog("BLUESKY TREE ON FEEDS: %@", app.debugDescription)
+    }
+}
*** End Patch
